# One-edit mutants, one block each: "id | file | what the edit removes", an optional "= reason" line (an
# equivalent mutant, listed and not run), then the old text ("- " lines) and the new text ("+ " lines).
clamp-low | src/limits.cpp | values below low are raised to low
- if (value < low) {
+ if (value < low - 1) {
clamp-high | src/limits.cpp | values above high are lowered to high
- if (value > high) {
+ if (false) {
step-limit | src/limits.cpp | the counter stops at kMax
- if (count >= kMax) {
+ if (count > kMax) {
max-value | include/limits.hpp | the limit is 100
- constexpr int kMax = 100;
+ constexpr int kMax = 101;
clamp-low-equal | src/limits.cpp | a value equal to low is returned either way
- if (value < low) {
+ if (value <= low) {
